title: Currawong CMS brand
description: A site's Studio (CMS) brand. Every field is optional; leave them all out to keep Currawong Creative's branding. Client settings win over Currawong's defaults.

$schema.description: Points the editor at this schema for autocomplete and validation. Ignored by the site.

name.description: The name shown in the Studio header and tab. Falls back to NEXT_PUBLIC_STUDIO_TITLE, then "Currawong Creative".

logo.description: Logo files from src/assets/brand/client/. Give only one of onLight and onDark and it is used for both. Run `npm run brand-assets` after adding files.

mark.description: A compact square mark for small spaces, such as the workspace icon.

colors.description: Setting any colour switches the whole Studio palette to the client's. Colours used as text or focus rings are lightened or darkened to meet WCAG contrast; `npm run check:studio-brand` lists each change.

primary.description: The main accent colour. To match the public site, copy the accent hex from src/styles/tokens.json.

secondary.description: A second colour for highlights. Derived from primary when left out.
